issues.label: Scope of remand mandate
issues.why: The court must determine whether Moore II limited remand to discrete corrections or authorized broader re-evaluation of property and child support.

issues.label: Law-of-the-case doctrine
issues.why: Prior appellate rulings bind the trial court and constrain what issues may be relitigated on remand.

issues.label: Use of trial-record vs. current income
issues.why: Whether R.C. 3119.04 permitted deciding final child support solely on 2016-2017 evidence rather than updated income data.

issues.label: Denial of evidentiary hearing on support
issues.why: Whether due process or the statute required a hearing on the child's current needs, lifestyle, and parental finances.

issues.label: Denial of discovery on Robert's income
issues.why: Whether refusing to compel updated financial discovery was error given the high-income determination.

issues.label: Application of R.C. 3119.04 high-income analysis
issues.why: Whether the court properly applied the over-maximum-income standard focused on needs and standard of living.

issues.label: Findings required under R.C. 3119.04(B)
issues.why: Whether the court made statutorily required findings when awarding an amount above the schedule maximum.

issues.label: Reasonableness of $8,500 monthly award
issues.why: Whether the specific support amount was supported by the child's needs and lifestyle evidence.

issues.label: Determination of child's actual needs
issues.why: Whether subtracting one nanny and using Exhibit BB accurately reflected the child's reasonable expenses.

issues.label: Standard of living / cost of living finding
issues.why: Whether it was reasonable to assume the child would live in Franklin or Belmont County.

issues.label: Determination of parents' incomes
issues.why: Whether the income figures for both parties, especially April's disputed law-firm income, were properly determined.

issues.label: Effective date of child support order
issues.why: Whether the January 1, 2020 date resolved the decree's contradictory retroactivity statements as directed.

issues.label: Retroactive reduction of support
issues.why: Whether reducing support backward in time and creating overpayment was permissible.

issues.label: Child support overpayment recovery
issues.why: Whether ordering repayment of $300,000+ via monthly offset was lawful and equitable.

issues.label: Recoupment of $153,000 other support
issues.why: Whether Robert could recover additional support amounts previously paid under temporary orders.

issues.label: Redesignation of childcare payments as gift
issues.why: Whether the court properly denied treating certain payments as gifts rather than child support.

issues.label: Temporary vs. final child support distinction
issues.why: Whether the interim $14,200 temporary order and final order were properly separated and reasoned.

issues.label: Cash medical support and expense allocation
issues.why: Whether the 70/30 split of extraordinary and school expenses and tuition/insurance obligations was proper.

issues.label: New Albany valuation at termination date
issues.why: Whether the court complied with the instruction to value the property as of January 1, 2016.

issues.label: Allocation of market loss on New Albany
issues.why: Whether declining to shift market loss/gain to a party was consistent with the mandate and equity.

issues.label: Failure to award New Albany to Robert
issues.why: Whether the court erred in not transferring ownership rather than dividing sale proceeds.

issues.label: Separate property interest calculations
issues.why: Whether Robert's separate interest percentages and dollar amounts were correctly computed.

issues.label: Attorney fee and repair credits offset
issues.why: Whether the $30,000 fee and $35,000 repair adjustments against proceeds were proper.

issues.label: Correction of Robert's Vero Beach award
issues.why: Whether the reduction to reflect the stipulated $1.7 million marital interest was correctly applied.

issues.label: Correction of debt allocations
issues.why: Whether the jet-services, tax, and account-withdrawal debts were properly reduced to 50 percent.

issues.label: Comprehensive division under R.C. 3105.171
issues.why: Whether the court was required to conduct a full de novo property division rather than piecemeal corrections.

issues.label: Overall equity of property division
issues.why: Whether the resulting division was equitable and justified as to April.

issues.label: Jurisdiction to modify property division
issues.why: Whether the court had authority to alter property awards beyond the remanded items.

issues.label: Denial of spousal support / waiver
issues.why: Whether April's October 2016 waiver validly barred her later spousal support motion.

issues.label: Denial of reimbursement for bills paid
issues.why: Whether refusing April's reimbursement claims as a 'double dip' was proper.

issues.label: De facto termination date of marriage
issues.why: Whether January 30, 2016 was the correct termination date affecting valuations and allocations.

issues.label: Final appealable order requirement
issues.why: Whether the ultimate order satisfied Civ.R. 75(F) and R.C. 2505.02 by consolidating all judgments.

issues.label: Reconsideration of final order
issues.why: Whether the June 12, 2023 entry was final and thus not subject to reconsideration.

issues.label: Adoption of Robert's proposed final order
issues.why: Whether incorporating prior entries by reference over April's objections was proper.

issues.label: Terminology of 'imputed' income
issues.why: Whether the court's characterization of April's estimated income affected the support calculation's validity.

issues.label: Dismissal of custodial account custodian
issues.why: Whether modifying the restraining order and dismissing the custodian affected substantial rights.
